error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the API. Check the URL and password. If the URL is correct, the Ökofen API may be rate-limiting requests - please wait a moment and try again.

abort.reconfiguration_successful: Configuration updated successfully. The integration is reloading - entities will become available within 1-2 minutes.

legacy_binary_sensors_under_sensor_domai.title: Old binary sensors still under the sensor.* domain
legacy_binary_sensors_under_sensor_domai.description:
Some entities from older versions of this integration look like binary sensors (pump on/off, fault contacts, etc.) but are still registered under the `sensor.*` domain. They will not get proper binary-sensor history.

Affected entities:

{entity_list}

**How to fix:** open *Settings → Devices & Services → Entities*, delete each entity above, then reload the Ökofen Pellematic integration. They will be recreated as `binary_sensor.*` entries.

Automations and dashboards that reference the old `sensor.*` IDs must be updated to the new `binary_sensor.*` IDs.
